title: eriogonum brevicaule subsp. orendense
intro: Eriogonum brevicaule subsp. orendense, commonly known as Orendorff's buckwheat flax, is a plant species belonging to the Polygonaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Eriogonum brevicaule subsp. orendense include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as exhibit antiseptic and antiviral actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
